text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Alles integriert und vorgefertigt in einer Einheit.", "gist": "The product is fully integrated and prefabricated as a single unit."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Watt d'Or 2016", "gist": "Watt d'Or award from 2016"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Designergy SA", "gist": "Company that won the award"}, {"type": "category", "quote": "Erneuerbare Energien", "gist": "Renewable Energies category"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Der Watt d'Or 2016 in der Kategorie Erneuerbare Energien geht an die Designergy SA für eine Weltneuheit, die nicht nur durch ihre einfache, rasche Installation, sondern auch durch ihr ansprechendes Design und durch tiefe Kosten besticht.", "gist": "Designergy SA won the 2016 Watt d'Or in Renewable Energies for a world-first product praised for easy installation, appealing design, and low costs."}, {"type": "category", "quote": "Energieeffiziente Mobilität", "gist": "Energy-efficient Mobility category"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SBB AG", "gist": "Swiss Federal Railways company"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Grüne Welle im Bahnverkehr – ADL", "gist": "Green Wave in rail traffic project"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Im Rahmen ihrer Energiestrategie", "gist": "As part of their energy strategy"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "konsequent Energie einsparen", "gist": "consistently save energy"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "bis 2025", "gist": "by the year 2025"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "insbesondere auch beim Stromverbrauch ihrer Personen- und Güterzüge", "gist": "particularly regarding electricity consumption of passenger and freight trains"}]}
